question: Should gogcli accept this combined lox keyring migration plus bundled 1Password provider after it is rebased onto current main, or should the 1Password direction be split or redirected?
rationale: The patch sits on the credential-storage boundary, overlaps an open dedicated 1Password PR, and conflicts with a newly merged Keychain ACL policy that CI and routine review cannot settle as a product/security choice.

options.title: Rebase And Prove Combined Migration
options.body: Require the branch to preserve current Keychain trust behavior, add redacted runtime proof, and then make an explicit dependency acceptance decision.

options.title: Split 1Password From Migration
options.body: Ask for a narrower lox keyring migration while leaving 1Password backend design to the dedicated open discussion.

options.title: Pause Or Redirect To `op` Bridge
options.body: Pause or close the combined branch if maintainers prefer a shell-out design for 1Password rather than a core provider dependency.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Prove Combined Migration
recommendation.body: Require the branch to preserve current Keychain trust behavior, add redacted runtime proof, and then make an explicit dependency acceptance decision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current Keychain trust policy and provided the prior maintainer direction on 1Password dependency tradeoffs.
